PASystemWebhookUrl.description: Discord webhook URL (must be HTTPS). If empty, the extension is disabled.

PASystemWebhookRoutes.description: Optional map of action kinds to dedicated webhook URLs (HTTPS). Kinds: edit, new, upload, delete, restore, move, protect, unprotect, block, unblock, newuser, rights, log, flood. Kinds without a route fall back to PASystemWebhookUrl. Example: {"block": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…", "delete": "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…"}.

PASystemBotName.description: Display name of the bot in Discord. If empty, the wiki's $wgSitename is used.

PASystemWikiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the wiki used to build links (e.g. https://example.org). If empty, derived from $wgServer + $wgScriptPath.

PASystemIncludedNamespaces.description: Namespace allowlist: when non-empty, only changes in these namespace numbers are announced (e.g. [0] for the main namespace only). Empty = all namespaces.

PASystemExcludedNamespaces.description: List of namespace numbers to exclude (e.g. [2, 3] to exclude User and User_talk).

PASystemExcludedUsers.description: List of user names to exclude from notifications.

PASystemNotifyBots.description: Notify edits made by bot accounts.

PASystemNotifyCategorization.description: Notify category membership changes (RC_CATEGORIZE rows). Off by default: a single edit can produce several of these technical entries.

PASystemNotifyExternal.description: Notify external changes (RC_EXTERNAL rows, e.g. Wikidata updates).

PASystemMaxPerMinute.description: Maximum number of announcements per minute (fixed window, shared across requests via the main object stash). When the cap is crossed, a single flood notice is sent and further announcements are dropped until the window resets. 0 = unlimited.

PASystemMinDiffSize.description: Minimum diff size (bytes) required to notify. 0 = notify all edits.

PASystemEmbedColors.description: Embed colors (decimal RGB) per action kind. Merged over the defaults, so you can override only the keys you need.

PASystemActionIcons.description: Emoji/icon shown per action kind (edit, new, upload, delete, restore, move, protect, unprotect, block, unblock, newuser, rights, log). Merged over the defaults, so you can override only the keys you need. Example: {"edit": "✏️"}.

PASystemDisplay.description: Display toggles, merged over the defaults. Keys (all true by default): 'icons' (emoji before each announcement), 'delta' (byte difference), 'summary' (edit summary), 'diffLink' (link to the diff), 'links' (links field in embed format), 'flags' (m/b flags in embed format), 'footer' (embed footer), 'timestamp' (embed timestamp). Example: {"icons": false, "delta": false}.

PASystemDebug.description: Enable verbose logging in the PublicAnnouncementSystem log channel.

PASystemDeliveryMode.description: Delivery mode: 'immediate' (POSTSEND DeferredUpdate, latency < 1s, no retry) or 'job' (JobQueue, automatic retries but latency depends on the JobRunner).

PASystemFormat.description: Discord message format: 'line' (compact one-line text message, default) or 'embed' (rich detailed embed with fields).

PASystemStripAutoSummaries.description: Hide summaries auto-generated by MediaWiki (e.g. "Created page with '...'"). Detection is based on the core autosumm-* messages in the wiki's content language. Manually entered summaries are always shown. Set to false to show everything, including content excerpts.
